Hocus Focus
A 7-week WhatsApp-based attention-regulation program for Israeli working mothers, run by Shany Orian in small groups of 7.

Primary page:
https://hocusfocus.shanyorian.com/

What it is:
A short daily WhatsApp message over seven weeks that helps a working mother move from reactivity back to choice, without adding another task-management system to her day.

Format: daily WhatsApp message, 7 weeks, groups of 7 women.
Language: Hebrew.
Price: 123 ILS (introductory price) for the full 7 weeks.

Keywords:
attention regulation, WhatsApp program, working mothers, burnout, focus, Hebrew, Israel

Contact:
shany@zikit.org
